title: The Deductible Still to Be Met on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Enrollment
content:
The deductible still to be met on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan is read from the plan's annual deductible and from what the member has already borne, and which measure of what they have borne is used turns on the length of their fill history. The plan treats 4 or more fills standing paid for the contract year as a long fill history.

1. Where the member's fills standing paid for the contract year are 4 or more and the out-of-pocket total standing on the enrollment is more than nothing, the deductible still to be met is the plan's annual deductible less that out-of-pocket total, and is never below nothing.
2. Where the member's fills standing paid for the contract year are fewer than 4 and the out-of-pocket total standing on the enrollment is more than nothing, the deductible still to be met is the plan's annual deductible less what the member has paid on fills with a fill date in the 6 months up to the handling date, and is never below nothing.
3. Where the out-of-pocket total standing on the enrollment is nothing or below, the deductible still to be met is the plan's annual deductible in full.

| Plan | Annual deductible (USD) |
| --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 615.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 615.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 480.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 300.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 150.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 0.0 |

## Worked on a hypothetical enrollment

Take a member on Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP), whose annual deductible is 480.0 USD, carrying an out-of-pocket total of 200.00 USD on the enrollment, and who has paid 120.00 USD on fills dated in the 6 months up to the handling date.

- With 5 fills standing paid for the contract year: the deductible still to be met is 480.0 USD less 200.00 USD, that is 280.00 USD.
- With 3 fills standing paid: the deductible still to be met is 480.0 USD less 120.00 USD, that is 360.00 USD.
- With an out-of-pocket total of nothing on the enrollment: the deductible still to be met is the whole 480.0 USD, whatever the fill history.
- Where the subtraction would fall below nothing, the deductible still to be met is nothing.
